states.title: Brief
states.what: misconception, claims, format, reviewRoute, priority; batches of 10-20 (the category owner, F-53; category-curator before it, company/company.json flows)

states.title: Build
states.what: build plus pre-flight; leaves when a check record exists for the current version or status is review

states.title: Checks
states.what: independent checks of the current version, each once

checks.what: npm run check, QA contract record stamped with the version, a11y-scan
learner walk of the current version with verdict launch

states.title: Revise (one round)
states.what: a check said revise, fail or disputed: one fix, re-run only the failed check, then publish or park

states.title: Launch record
states.what: every gate passes: batch launch record with predictions, then release-manager publishes

states.title: Published
states.what: status published on main, not yet in a production deploy (company/ops/releases.json); the founder approves every deploy

states.title: Live
states.what: the published version is in a production deploy recorded in company/ops/releases.json
